title: Test infrastructure refactor — four gates, one helper, one probe
status: COMPLETE — toolchain verified against a live DSH session

motivation.problem: Not 'too many tests'. A dead host was treated as a product defect and debugged by trial and error for most of the phase.

rootCauses: host refused to load its own session log (event type 'job/registered' written by a newer harness)
browser-skill CLI 0.4.0 against extension 0.4.1 — protocol skew made every fill crash the host draft editor

perCharacterTyping.actualFix: fill + press('Enter') = 2 calls, after the CLI was updated to match the extension

deliverables.protocols: reads both 1.7 and 1.8 shapes of cooperate sync
hardening: every bsk subprocess is time-bounded (BSK_CALL_TIMEOUT_MS, default 20000)
transient refusals (observation_changed, content changed, covered) are retried; anything else surfaces immediately

deliberateOmissions.type: per-character typing — recorded as a mistake, asserted absent by parity.mjs

deliverables.what: parameterized probe: gates first, measurement second

gates.name: environment
checks: page can load its session log
no host draft-editor crash in console

gates.name: input
gates.asserts: fill delivers all 31 characters including non-ASCII in one action

gates.name: submit
gates.asserts: Enter submits — composer clears AND the marker appears in the conversation

gates.name: render
gates.asserts: >= 2 paragraphs painted and the turn settles

deliverables.gateOrderingRationale: cheapest first, because evaluating against an about:blank tab HANGS instead of failing — tab list needs no cooperation context, so that case is answered without touching the page

exitCodes.1: product failure (only this may be filed as FAIL)

blockingPropagation.forceFlag: bypasses for diagnosis, prints a warning, marks result forced:true

deliverables.what: static check that the canonical helper covers every historical copy
failsOn: an exported name the canonical helper lacks (unless recorded in DROPPED)
the return of the per-character typing loop

deliverables.what: the manual — gates, usage, exit-code semantics, cost accounting
the binding rule: diagnose environment -> verify interaction -> verify product
alsoBinds: single spec while iterating, full suite once before recording numbers
read the page before probing it

deliverables.what: marks the old cdp copies as history — the copies themselves are unedited

g0FailsFastOnBlankTab.message: G0 environment: the agent tab is still about:blank — it must be navigated to the DSH app before measuring
g0FailsFastOnBlankTab.note: before the fix this case hung; the same run had to be backgrounded and killed

fullSmoke.incidental: G0 also reported the 2 existing 4A-1 cards and 0 draft-editor crashes

cases.message: no smoke pass recorded — run --what=smoke before any product measurement
the smoke pass was for session rkct, not wrongsid

parity.result: every historical copy's exports are covered; the single absence is `type`, recorded as a mistake

productMeasurementsReuseExistingEvidence.card: found the 4A-1 card (2 copies, 680px, 0 unresolved variables, 0 dangling host tokens) — 0.2s
productMeasurementsReuseExistingEvidence.tokens: read the card root's variables against the host — 0.2s
productMeasurementsReuseExistingEvidence.theme: dark via the host's own Settings -> 通用设置 -> 外观 control; after = {dark:true, scheme:dark}, matching the 4A-1 record; restored to light afterwards — 12.3s

costBaselineFor4A2Comparison.note: Recorded as measured facts about THIS refactor, not as a claimed multiplier. 4A-2 must record the same metrics so the comparison is data.

thisRefactor.failedRetryCause: observation_changed on the first step call, fixed by adding transient retry to step()

untouched.phase4a1Verdicts: NOT redefined. 8 of 9 gate items pass; A9 remains NOT VERIFIED because the profile's older session is unreadable by this host build. The refactor changed tooling, not findings.
untouched.phase4a1Evidence: not deleted, not rewritten. The old cdp copies stay exactly as those runs executed them.
